_doc: The SPOF, failure-mode and control-disposition registers of the guiding directive (sections 12, 13, 16). Every entry names an owner, a trigger, a remediation and a closing probe that `python3 -m foundation directive --check` runs; a SPOF is only 'remediated' when its second path is exercised (an exercise probe that resolves). Probing cadence is in ticks; `directive --probe` writes evidence to doctrine/probe-log.jsonl (append-only). Changed only by a reviewed PR.

spofs.what: ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN is the only route to the public GitHub org page
spofs.remediation: second path: gate card docs/ops/ORG-TOKEN.md with the holding page as the default in effect

spofs.what: one runtime host running the tick
spofs.remediation: failover to the next host and the Python selfhost path

spofs.what: any step waiting on the owner for reversible work
spofs.trigger: an item waits on a person
spofs.remediation: interrupt gate is narrow; owner steps become gate cards with a default in effect

spofs.what: project or tool memory as a store of facts
spofs.trigger: a required fact is absent from the repo
spofs.remediation: doctrine/durable-facts.json check; the repo is the only memory
bundle export and platform adapters (gap SG-1)

spofs.what: the agent-executor depends on one model credential (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
spofs.remediation: provider interface (seed/worker/src/executor.js, foundation/executor.py); the cloud-hosted Claude routine runs the executor without a model key; gate card NEEDS-YOU.md

spofs.what: the move to the dedicated Cloudflare account needs one token covering it
spofs.remediation: old account keeps ticking; the GitHub Actions executor and the cloud-hosted routine continue; gate card NEEDS-YOU.md; staged plan deploy/transfer/plan.json

failure_modes.trigger: an agent report ends in a question, menu or approval request
failure_modes.symptom: work waits on the owner
failure_modes.blast_radius: autonomy rate
failure_modes.root_cause: decision deferred instead of made
failure_modes.remediation: lint fails the report; rewrite as decision plus assumption

failure_modes.trigger: an item leaves the active set without a disposition
failure_modes.symptom: accounting invariant imbalance
failure_modes.blast_radius: backlog integrity
failure_modes.root_cause: closure without recording
failure_modes.remediation: accounting check fails the tick

failure_modes.trigger: same action fails with the same signature
failure_modes.symptom: repeated retries
failure_modes.blast_radius: cycle budget
failure_modes.root_cause: approach not mutated
failure_modes.remediation: mutate on 2nd failure, incident on 3rd

failure_modes.trigger: a blocker is reported with fewer surfaces tested than available
failure_modes.symptom: blocker handed to the owner
failure_modes.blast_radius: surface_coverage
failure_modes.root_cause: one surface tested then stopped
failure_modes.remediation: blocker log requires all surfaces and evidence

failure_modes.trigger: a durable fact exists only in project or tool memory
failure_modes.symptom: fact lost when memory is disabled
failure_modes.blast_radius: all agents
failure_modes.root_cause: write-back skipped
failure_modes.remediation: facts register with repo probes fails CI

failure_modes.trigger: the Cloudflare cron or D1 binding stops, or a host path breaks the local tick
failure_modes.symptom: no tick_runs, loops stop closing
failure_modes.blast_radius: every autonomous loop
failure_modes.root_cause: a platform path or binding assumption (Windows drive-letter paths, unbound D1)
failure_modes.remediation: detector files AUDIT-selfhost-tick; liveness metrics M-tick-heartbeat and M-acting breach in the tick

failure_modes.trigger: a change merges while a suite is red on a host the CI does not cover
failure_modes.symptom: foundation or seed tests fail
failure_modes.blast_radius: trust in every other probe
failure_modes.root_cause: environment-dependent tests (symlinks, CRLF bytes, absolute paths) and unchecked regressions
failure_modes.remediation: detector files AUDIT-<id> with evidence; the executor drains it

failure_modes.trigger: the public worker stops answering
failure_modes.symptom: ultrastable.io/health not ok
failure_modes.blast_radius: all public surfaces and the front door
failure_modes.root_cause: bad deploy or route
failure_modes.remediation: detector files AUDIT-site-health; canary revert applies

failure_modes.trigger: agent files, bootstrap or front door stop carrying the system test
failure_modes.symptom: a one-off app is staffed or the vision is missing
failure_modes.blast_radius: cost and credibility
failure_modes.root_cause: a doctrine file edited without its enforcement test
failure_modes.remediation: tests/test_vision.py fails the build

failure_modes.trigger: a probe type ships without a test
failure_modes.symptom: a metric silently reads wrong
failure_modes.blast_radius: every objective measured by that probe
failure_modes.root_cause: probe kinds added without coverage
failure_modes.remediation: measure.test.js covers builtin, sql and http probes

failure_modes.trigger: a pin or roadmap item is added without code, proof or a probe-backed issue, or an issue ships with a prose done check
failure_modes.symptom: the site says something no code can confirm
failure_modes.blast_radius: credibility of every public claim
failure_modes.root_cause: status typed by hand instead of computed from code
failure_modes.remediation: status is computed; new unprobed issues fail the build; the baseline only shrinks

failure_modes.trigger: a server-side merge sees mergeable_state clean while the full checks run is pending, absent or red (main has no required checks)
failure_modes.symptom: a change that fails checks lands on main (#595, #596)
failure_modes.blast_radius: main or a deploy goes red, then the executor and ciwatch file repair items for it
failure_modes.root_cause: clean only means no required check is red
failure_modes.remediation: greenguard.notGreen gates the tick lane and sweeper; scripts/lane.sh requires a green `checks` run

failure_modes.trigger: main moves under the lane adoption commit and a generated file conflicts in the rebase
failure_modes.symptom: every later pull fails with unmerged files and the lane run is red (run 1061)
failure_modes.blast_radius: main or a deploy goes red, then the executor and ciwatch file repair items for it
failure_modes.root_cause: a half-finished rebase was left in the work tree
failure_modes.remediation: abort the rebase, reset to origin/main, redo the idempotent adoption

failure_modes.trigger: a merge lands on main while regen-generated is running
failure_modes.symptom: the non-fast-forward push fails the job (runs 12 and 13)
failure_modes.blast_radius: main or a deploy goes red, then the executor and ciwatch file repair items for it
failure_modes.root_cause: a single unretried push to a moving branch
failure_modes.remediation: fetch, reset to main, regenerate, push again, up to 4 tries; never force

failure_modes.trigger: a Q-CIFAIL item names a workflow in another repository
failure_modes.symptom: the executor edits unrelated files in this repository and merges them
failure_modes.blast_radius: main or a deploy goes red, then the executor and ciwatch file repair items for it
failure_modes.root_cause: the item was takeable in any repository
failure_modes.remediation: executor.foreign_cifail removes it from the takeable set; ciwatch closes it by probe

failure_modes.trigger: a session merges a PR with its own token while the full checks run is pending or red (#619, two seconds after the run started)
failure_modes.symptom: main fails a check that the PR run had caught
failure_modes.blast_radius: main and the next deploy
failure_modes.root_cause: branch protection cannot require checks without blocking the lane's direct pushes, so a token-level merge is not gated in code
failure_modes.remediation: mergeaudit files Q-CIFAIL-mergeaudit-N for every merge without a green checks run, every lane pass

failure_modes.trigger: a failure mode has no live detector, or a failing detector has no open item in the executor's queue
failure_modes.symptom: a failure is seen every day and nothing takes it
failure_modes.blast_radius: every failure mode: detection without resolution
failure_modes.root_cause: findings were written where no loop reads them (a branch, an id no queue pattern matches, a done check that is no probe kind)
failure_modes.remediation: failure_audit files Q-AUDIT-<id> on main with a cmd: closing probe; --check fails on an unwatched mode or an unfiled finding

failure_modes.trigger: any item, PR, report or loop whose next step is a person reading, approving, merging or deciding (owner directive 2026-11-21: a thread showing as waiting on the owner is itself a failure)
failure_modes.symptom: a PR, issue or report sits or ends as 'waiting on' or 'leaving to' a person
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that takes input from a code agent or a person
failure_modes.detection: python3 -m foundation closedloop --check (human_wait_states) and the lane's held list
failure_modes.root_cause: an input was treated as needing a reply instead of being taken as given: drafts left unready, merges left to approval, results phrased as hand-backs
failure_modes.remediation: every input is incorporated by the server-side loop: the lane marks a finished draft ready and merges it on green, the sweeper carries a stuck PR, and only an identity-bound act becomes one gate with a default in effect
failure_modes.probe: grep:seed/worker/src/lane.js::a draft with finished work is marked ready by the lane

failure_modes.trigger: an area, loop or entry drifts over days: a hotspot of churn, a neglected or decaying area, a loop that stopped firing, a failure that keeps repeating
failure_modes.symptom: a snapshot looks fine while the series shows one part being rewritten over and over and another not touched at all
failure_modes.blast_radius: any component, loop or tenant entry; the failure surfaces late, after it has already become an outage or a stale record
failure_modes.detection: python3 -m foundation temporal --probe (findings that stood for escalate_runs runs); series at /trends
failure_modes.root_cause: the system was judged on snapshots, so trends were invisible until they broke
failure_modes.remediation: temporal files Q-TEMPORAL items owned by the area's advocate, pathfinder --regress lists the suspect commits, queue attention weights rise for neglected areas and fall for hot ones

failure_modes.trigger: a dependency manifest is added or kept with no update bot watching it
failure_modes.symptom: unpatched or deprecated dependencies accumulate over a year
failure_modes.blast_radius: security and build breakage across a year unattended
failure_modes.root_cause: no Dependabot entry for the manifest
failure_modes.remediation: add the entry to .github/dependabot.yml; Dependabot PRs merge through the lane

failure_modes.trigger: a finding is fixed at its symptom and the same root cause produces it again
failure_modes.symptom: the same class of failure returns on a later day under a new name
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop the root cause reaches; repeated effort with no capability gain
failure_modes.root_cause: no root-cause class owns the finding, or its guard is absent or ineffective
failure_modes.remediation: rootcause escalates a class seen on two days to Q-ROOT-<class>: build the guard, or redesign the one that failed

failure_modes.trigger: a PR or issue stays open past its written limit in doctrine/sla.json
failure_modes.symptom: a conflicting, red, unchecked or draft PR (or an old issue) sits for hours with only a comment
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that waits on the item; the drain-to-zero target
failure_modes.root_cause: the green-PR watcher ignores every non-green class and the sweeper superseded agent/ branches only
failure_modes.remediation: the tick Worker sweeper supersedes a non-merge-ready PR past hard_min and files one PORT-BRANCH item; slawatch fails loudly on any breach

failure_modes.trigger: the hosted provider retires the models a rung names
failure_modes.symptom: the executor's author ladder answers 410 and loses rungs
failure_modes.blast_radius: code-agent capacity
failure_modes.root_cause: source names a model id after the provider retired it
failure_modes.remediation: MODEL-HEAL-1: the rung runs the catalog successor and records the 410; modelwatch --observed --apply rewrites source

failure_modes.trigger: two changes collide in a generated or append-only file
failure_modes.symptom: a green PR cannot merge
failure_modes.blast_radius: merge lane throughput
failure_modes.root_cause: generated and append-only files edited on both sides
failure_modes.remediation: scripts/resolve_generated.py keeps both sides and regenerates from main

failure_modes.trigger: the day's AI allowance or a cost spike is reached
failure_modes.symptom: model calls stop for the rest of the day
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that calls a model
failure_modes.root_cause: a hard cap instead of a soft throttle
failure_modes.remediation: the budget governor steps normal, lean, frozen and back the next day

failure_modes.trigger: GitHub's scheduler or Actions skips runs
failure_modes.symptom: a clock goes silent
failure_modes.blast_radius: every scheduled loop
failure_modes.root_cause: one clock with no second host
failure_modes.remediation: foundation/failover.decide hands the loops to another host past its takeover threshold

failure_modes.trigger: a rule, claim, change or target the system states is not what its code does
failure_modes.symptom: words and code drift apart
failure_modes.blast_radius: trust in every surface
failure_modes.root_cause: a statement added or changed without the code or probe that makes it true
failure_modes.remediation: SAY-DO-1 files one Q-SAYDO item per gap, closed only by its probe; the executor refuses a change that names an item and touches no code

failure_modes.trigger: the daily intent-yield run stops, errors, or its parser stops finding the owner's directives because their format changed
failure_modes.symptom: /yield shows an old date or a falling count of directives while the directives themselves keep changing
failure_modes.blast_radius: the yield page and the Q-YIELD items; directives that stopped holding go unnoticed
failure_modes.detection: python3 -m foundation intentyield --probe (state older than stale_hours, an error recorded, fewer than min_intents parsed, or no probe run)
failure_modes.root_cause: a loop whose only proof of life is its own output stops without anything reading that output
failure_modes.remediation: the failure audit files Q-AUDIT-intent-yield-fresh for the executor; the watchdog restarts the intent-yield clock; the parser refuses a run that loses more than half the directives

failure_modes.trigger: a seed or generated system is deployed that cannot run a year unattended, or the template rots so the next generated system cannot
failure_modes.symptom: a new system's worker fails to start, a loop is missing, or a drill fails on its first week
failure_modes.blast_radius: every system generated from the seed
failure_modes.root_cause: the seed's tests, imports or kernel paths depend on the platform's own layout, or a loop was left out of the generator
failure_modes.remediation: SEED-ADMIT-1: the generator wires the kit and runs the year simulation on the new system; a held seed is not launched; the probe re-onboards the template on every audit

failure_modes.trigger: a seed is admitted but no Worker for it runs on the Ultrastable account, or its /health stops answering
failure_modes.symptom: the system exists in the simulation only
failure_modes.blast_radius: every seed built on the platform
failure_modes.root_cause: core had no server-side step that deploys a generated system
failure_modes.remediation: SEED-DEPLOY-1: deploy/deploy-seed.mjs deploys each seed in doctrine/seed-deploys.json after the platform workers and probes /health; the detector fetches it live

failure_modes.trigger: a seed (repo from ultrastable/seed or seed/ here) cannot be built, deployed, year-gated and probed live with no person
failure_modes.symptom: an idea sits in a repository with no running system, or a running system that cannot last a year unattended
failure_modes.blast_radius: every tenant and new system built on Ultrastable
failure_modes.root_cause: the seed depends on files outside itself, a drill regressed, or a provision step changed
failure_modes.remediation: seed-launch.yml launches a fresh seed and every seeded repository weekly on Ultrastable's own account; a failed stage files Q-AUDIT-seed-launch for the executor

failure_modes.trigger: a seed is deployed and answers /health, but its own loops fail or never record a run
failure_modes.symptom: the launch record says passed while the seed's tick reports stalled, at ignition stage ticking
failure_modes.blast_radius: every seed built on the platform: each would count as launched without being able to change or repair itself
failure_modes.root_cause: the launch gate judged a seed on /health alone, and the deploy step binds no source-control credential, so repository loops cannot run
failure_modes.remediation: SEED-AUTONOMY-1: /health carries the seed's own ignition stage; past 48 hours a seed below looping fails the detector, which files Q-AUDIT-seed-autonomous for the executor

failure_modes.trigger: a tenant worker's /health is not ok, or reports a part with ok false (What Works, 2026-11-25: clock ticking while OpenAlex answered 429 and Europe PMC 503 on every call, so no programme was ever checked)
failure_modes.symptom: the tenant's page shows 0% checked or stale data while its liveness probe passes
failure_modes.blast_radius: one tenant's public data and every loop that reads it
failure_modes.root_cause: liveness probes read only the clock, not whether the loop's work reached its sources
failure_modes.remediation: TENANT-HEALTH-1: tenants report each part of their loop in /health with its own ok; the tenant-health detector reads every tenant live and files Q-AUDIT-tenant-health

failure_modes.trigger: a published page's visible text does not change for max_unchanged_days
failure_modes.symptom: the system looks frozen to a visitor; content is not autonomous
failure_modes.blast_radius: reach, stickiness and the claim that the system runs itself
failure_modes.root_cause: the page is hand-typed or a snapshot with no loop that regenerates it
failure_modes.remediation: bind the page to a loop; the detector's Q-AUDIT item names the page

failure_modes.trigger: a generator stops or its output never reaches main
failure_modes.symptom: a public page shows data days old
failure_modes.blast_radius: public pages and every loop that reads them
failure_modes.root_cause: generator not scheduled, or its file rides a PR that goes red
failure_modes.remediation: failure-audit files a Q-AUDIT item with suspects; the detector is its closing probe

failure_modes.trigger: a scheduled workflow fails every run
failure_modes.symptom: the loop does nothing and nobody sees it (seed kit-sync, 11-22 to 11-25)
failure_modes.blast_radius: public pages and every loop that reads them
failure_modes.root_cause: no check reads scheduled run outcomes across the org
failure_modes.remediation: failure-audit files a Q-AUDIT item with suspects; the detector is its closing probe

failure_modes.trigger: a job or loop reports success while its result never arrives
failure_modes.symptom: zero output, stale ledger, skipped schedule
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that reports success without a result
failure_modes.root_cause: probes read the job, not the result
failure_modes.remediation: detector files Q-AUDIT, executor fixes, same detector closes it

failure_modes.trigger: a run waits at action_required or an event by the built-in token triggers nothing
failure_modes.symptom: PRs and issues sit untaken
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that reports success without a result
failure_modes.root_cause: GitHub does not run or approve workflows for token-made events
failure_modes.remediation: detector files Q-AUDIT, executor fixes, same detector closes it

failure_modes.trigger: Worker source cannot bundle
failure_modes.symptom: deploy fails after merge
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that reports success without a result
failure_modes.root_cause: no pre-merge bundle check
failure_modes.remediation: detector files Q-AUDIT, executor fixes, same detector closes it

failure_modes.trigger: a module is built twice
failure_modes.symptom: two modules do one job
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that reports success without a result
failure_modes.root_cause: no pre-build overlap check
failure_modes.remediation: detector files Q-AUDIT, executor fixes, same detector closes it

failure_modes.trigger: done is claimed without a live reading
failure_modes.symptom: public surface wrong while a PR says fixed
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that reports success without a result
failure_modes.root_cause: agents cannot reach public hosts and nothing demanded a server-side reading
failure_modes.remediation: detector files Q-AUDIT, executor fixes, same detector closes it

failure_modes.trigger: a model route fails on large tasks
failure_modes.symptom: executor runs fail on every rung
failure_modes.blast_radius: every loop that reports success without a result
failure_modes.root_cause: one route, no probe per rung
failure_modes.remediation: detector files Q-AUDIT, executor fixes, same detector closes it

failure_modes.trigger: a fact the repository declares (repository visibility, a registry row, a visual baseline) differs from the live system
failure_modes.symptom: a tenant repository private while declared public; CI and deploys cannot read it
failure_modes.blast_radius: the tenant's CI, deploy and public directory listing
failure_modes.root_cause: declared facts were applied once at creation and never read back
failure_modes.remediation: the tick's repo-visibility loop sets drift back hourly; the uiux run rolls stale baselines

failure_modes.trigger: a tenant back end's only route to run is its own Cron Trigger and the account's trigger limit or a deploy drops it
failure_modes.symptom: a back end with no beat for days while its page still serves
failure_modes.blast_radius: every tenant back end and the loops reading it
failure_modes.root_cause: clocks depended on one account-wide quota nobody counted
failure_modes.remediation: the tick pulses every tenant's /pulse/watch hourly; crons are counted against the plan limit

failure_modes.trigger: a push on main matches a workflow's push paths and starts no run
failure_modes.symptom: a workflow that should have run after a merge never did
failure_modes.blast_radius: whatever that workflow creates or deploys
failure_modes.root_cause: pushes made with a run's own token start no workflow and nothing compared pushes with runs
failure_modes.remediation: the watchdog dispatches a workflow whose matching push started no run

failure_modes.trigger: a bot commits without comparing trees and its own push re-triggers it
failure_modes.symptom: dozens of empty commits on one branch, each starting CI
failure_modes.blast_radius: Actions minutes and the merge lane
failure_modes.root_cause: no tree comparison before commit
failure_modes.remediation: MERGENOW-NOOP-1; the detector counts empty commits per branch

failure_modes.trigger: a lane item's PR merges or closes and the item stays open
failure_modes.symptom: queue items open for work already merged
failure_modes.blast_radius: queue balance and drain metrics
failure_modes.root_cause: the item's state was set when the PR opened and nothing read the PR back
failure_modes.remediation: LANE-FILED-FAIL-1 closes OL-PR-<n> by its loopowner --closed probe; the handoff closer reads merges back

failure_modes.trigger: a credential reaches a different Cloudflare account than the topology names
failure_modes.symptom: deploys fail or land on a retired account
failure_modes.blast_radius: every Worker deploy
failure_modes.root_cause: credentials were moved by hand with no comparison to the topology
failure_modes.remediation: the watchdog compares the account the token reaches with the topology, by hash for retired ones

failure_modes.trigger: a row or report says built or done without a live reading
failure_modes.symptom: a graph marked built with no nodes; a PR verified only by the tick's /health
failure_modes.blast_radius: every claim of done
failure_modes.root_cause: state was written by the agent that wrote the code
failure_modes.remediation: built rows must answer their probe with nodes; checks refuse a deploy verified only by the tick's /health

failure_modes.trigger: the Replication Ledger's beat never checks some seed DOIs at Crossref, or a check finds a mismatched citation
failure_modes.symptom: /api/citations reported a count of checks with no total, so a DOI never verified read the same as a verified one
failure_modes.blast_radius: every Replication Ledger page that cites a seed paper, and the standings computed from those citations
failure_modes.detection: detector replication-ledger-citations: GET https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/api/citations answers 503 with ok false after 24 beats while any seed DOI is unchecked or failed
failure_modes.root_cause: the citation endpoint counted rows checked instead of comparing them with the seed's DOIs
failure_modes.remediation: citations() in instances/replication-ledger/worker/index.js reports total, checked, unchecked and failed against seedCites(); failure-audit files a Q-AUDIT item and the detector is its closing probe
failure_modes.probe: grep:instances/replication-ledger/worker/citations.test.mjs::after 24 beats an unchecked seed DOI makes /api/citations answer 503

failure_modes.trigger: a page keeps a sentence whose endpoint is gone, an endpoint ships that no page describes, or a system does not serve a contract surface
failure_modes.symptom: a reader sees a capability the back end does not serve, or the back end serves one nobody can find; the platform cannot read the system the way it reads the others
failure_modes.blast_radius: every public surface of the platform and of each tenant
failure_modes.detection: fleetcontract --live (detector fleet-contract), and each system's own contract test
failure_modes.root_cause: words and routes declared in separate places with nothing tying a sentence to its page and its endpoint
failure_modes.remediation: one declaration per system (seed/worker/src/contract.js); detector files Q-AUDIT, the system is fixed in its own repository, the same reading closes it

failure_modes.trigger: a manager is added to the roster after a system booted, a runtime drops a role row, or the dispatch step stops running
failure_modes.symptom: the role file exists and items are filed to that owner, but the runtime has no row for it or its dispatch beat stopped, so nothing takes its items: a title, not a manager
failure_modes.blast_radius: every item owned by that role, in the platform and in each system made from the seed
failure_modes.detection: managers --live (detector managers-live) reads the runtime's own role rows and beats; managers --check on every change
failure_modes.root_cause: the roles table was written once at bootstrap and never reconciled with the roster
failure_modes.remediation: seed/worker/src/managers.js hireStep runs inside the tick's reconcile step and hires every switched-on manager with no runtime row; the detector files Q-AUDIT-managers-live and the same reading closes it
failure_modes.probe: grep:seed/worker/test/managers.test.js::a system that booted with part of the team is brought to the full register by one tick

failure_modes.trigger: a change breaks a standard the system has adopted, a new config or generated commit title arrives outside it, or a public address stops answering in the standard's form
failure_modes.symptom: other tools, agents and people read a boundary (an event, an error body, a manifest, a page's markup, a repository's descriptor) that no longer follows the format they expect, while the register still says it does
failure_modes.blast_radius: every boundary other systems read: events between loops, API errors, configs and manifests, page markup, repository metadata
failure_modes.detection: standards --check on every change and standards --live daily (detectors standards-register and standards-live); the probes rest on foundation/schemas.py (the JSON Schema validator behind configschema), foundation/cloudevents.py (the event envelope) and foundation/commitlint.py (generated commit titles)
failure_modes.root_cause: conformance declared in a document instead of measured by a probe that runs
failure_modes.remediation: each register row carries probes that run in checks and in the failure audit; a failing probe files Q-AUDIT-standards-register or Q-AUDIT-standards-live with the changed files as suspects and the same probe closes it; a new release of an adopted standard is filed by the scout from its release feed

controls.note: doctrine, out of scope for disposition (directive section 13)

controls.what: actions-budget.json minute kill switch for non-essential workflows
controls.note: demoted off the critical path: essential workflows ignore it; non-essential ones degrade to the zero-minute alternative

controls.what: outreach rate caps, opt-outs and kill switch
controls.note: protects against mass contact (a catastrophic mode); opt-outs always win

controls.what: human merge approval on reversible work
controls.note: replaced by green CI, independent review and automatic rollback by revert; directive: no merge approvals

controls.what: ultrastable/workers CODEOWNERS plus the protected-change label: a human must approve any change under protected paths such as .github/workflows/
controls.note: Found 2026-11-12 on workers PR #107: it blocks the release workflow, so tags cannot be cut without a person. Target: replace with required checks (ci, contract) plus a bot approval and path guards, so protected paths stay protected without a person on the critical path. Not bypassed in the meantime. Owner: the thread 'Enforce closed loops across all repos and agents'. Off the tick's critical path (the tick and lane run without tags); it blocks only release tagging, so it is demoted, not a stop.
controls.replacement: required checks plus the automated protected-path gate (workers selfhost_check.py and canary_revert.py); the merge lane merges on green. Queue item OL-20261112-15 carries it until the probe passes.

controls.what: CODEOWNERS human approver on protected paths
controls.replacement: automated protected-path check (foundation/closedloop.py controls_check, scripts/protected_paths.py) plus required status checks; the bot lane approves on green

controls.what: Protected-change label and human reviewer line
controls.replacement: the same check requires a Protected-change: reason line in the PR body and fails any diff that weakens a guard
required checks plus automatic revert on a failed post-merge probe
